observation: 0.0255 m contact prevents coincidence but 32-iteration Poly6 tank still about 11% too shallow despite tiny density residual.
hypothesis: Kernel self-sampling and clustered quadrature permit a density-correct but volume-wrong particle configuration.
new_single_control: Increase only contact distance from 0.0255 to 0.04 m (0.8 nominal spacing); compare at fixed other parameters, then compare Spiky and Poly6 separately.
caveat: An active exclusion radius is a changed PBF particle model. Do not claim it is neutral or continuum physical accuracy; reject excess energy, shear-like piles, bad hydrostatics or nonconvergence.
criteria: No changes to original acceptance criteria.
